settings.slot.radio.label: Radio
settings.slot.radio.help: the wireless host: off; bluetooth, as radio_type; dongle, our dongle, which shows radio_type on its usb port.  A usb host on the cable wins while usb_type is set
settings.slot.radio_type.label: Radio type
settings.slot.radio_type.help: what the bluetooth host sees, or with the dongle what its usb port shows (a type with usb); changing the bluetooth host renews address and clears bond
settings.slot.usb_type.label: Usb type
settings.slot.usb_type.help: what a usb host on the cable sees, as a wired controller; none: no usb, the cable only charges (and is the tool device)
settings.slot.connect_colour.label: Connect colour
settings.slot.connect_colour.help: Home and player lights while connecting and pairing: which slot
settings.slot.primary_colour.label: Primary colour
settings.slot.primary_colour.help: Home while connected; the player lights around the player number
settings.slot.secondary_colour.label: Secondary colour
settings.slot.secondary_colour.help: the console's player number; resting grips; the other end of fade
settings.slot.grips.label: Grips
settings.slot.grips.help: grip lights while connected: host is the console's lightbar colour; fade, rumble, input, rainbow and heartbeat are animations, lit brighter than the steady colours
settings.slot.players.label: Players
settings.slot.players.help: player lights while connected: host is the console's player number; fade and rainbow are animations, lit brighter than the steady colours
settings.slot.address.label: Address
settings.slot.address.help: the slot's own address, least significant byte first; zero: derived
settings.slot.bond.label: Bond
settings.slot.bond.help: the paired host: peer, link key, key type, LE peer, LTK
settings.slot.report_hz.label: Report hz
settings.slot.report_hz.help: most reports per second, Classic and LE, whole milliseconds apart; reports are built when the radio has room; 0: 250
settings.slot.le_interval_min.label: Le interval min
settings.slot.le_interval_min.help: LE: connection interval to ask for, 1.25 ms units (6 = 7.5 ms); 0: the profile's
settings.slot.le_interval_max.label: Le interval max
settings.slot.le_interval_max.help: LE: the longest interval to accept; 0: le_interval_min
settings.slot.le_phy.label: Le phy
settings.slot.le_phy.help: LE: 2m asks the host for the 2M PHY
settings.slot.in_flight.label: In flight
settings.slot.in_flight.help: input reports in the controller at once; 0: 2
settings.slot.poll_us.label: Poll us
settings.slot.poll_us.help: Classic: Best Effort poll request in us (3750 minimum, rounded down to 1250 steps); 0: none
settings.slot.pull_delay_us.label: Pull delay us
settings.slot.pull_delay_us.help: build a report this long after the radio asks for it (fresher, until it misses the connection event)
settings.slot.jit_us.label: Jit us
settings.slot.jit_us.help: build a report this long before the connection event or sniff anchor it goes out at; 0: adaptive; 1: as soon as the radio has room
settings.slot.edr3.label: Edr3
settings.slot.edr3.help: Classic: 3 Mbit/s packets (an 83-byte PlayStation report fits one, but a Linux host stalled more often); off: 2 Mbit/s only
settings.slot.sniff_max.label: Sniff max
settings.slot.sniff_max.help: Classic: ask the host for sniff, at most this many 0.625 ms slots (even); 0: take what the host chooses
settings.slot.sniff_min.label: Sniff min
settings.slot.sniff_min.help: Classic: the shortest sniff interval asked for; 0: sniff_max
settings.slot.tx_power.label: Tx power
settings.slot.tx_power.help: radio strength 1-6: 1 is about 20 dB below 5; 6 about 3 dB above 5, using more battery
settings.slot.remap.label: Remap
settings.slot.remap.help: the remap each connect starts with: base, or a remap slot (which takes what it has not set from base); Home+M then a slot key picks another until a disconnect, another slot or sleep
settings.slot.usb_audio.label: Usb audio
settings.slot.usb_audio.help: on USB, the personality's sound card (a board with one): jack, while something is in the jack, USB coming back as that changes; on; off

settings.palette.steady_brightness.label: Steady brightness
settings.palette.steady_brightness.help: Home and the player lights while connected, and steady grips: tenths of the LEDs' smallest step (10 is 1 of 255); in-between values need dithering
settings.palette.animation_brightness.he: animated grips and player lights (fade, rumble, input, rainbow, heartbeat), in tenths of the LEDs' smallest step
settings.palette.connect_brightness.help: the lights while connecting and pairing, in tenths of the LEDs' smallest step
settings.palette.dither_ms.label: Dither ms
settings.palette.dither_ms.help: experiment: refresh dim lights this often (ms), alternating the steps on either side, for brightness between them and smooth dim fades; 0 off
settings.calibration.calibration.label: Calibration
settings.calibration.calibration.help: sensor calibration for sticks and triggers; legacy stick deadzones ignored
settings.remap.name.label: Name
settings.remap.name.help: what this remap is for; UTF-8, up to 24 bytes
settings.remap.map.label: Map
settings.remap.map.help: each key's base row: while held it sends itself (default), another key or nothing; its rules add to that
settings.remap.rules.label: Rules
settings.remap.rules.help: up to {count}: when a key is held, held for, pressed, released, tapped or double-tapped, hold, turbo, tap or toggle other keys, nothing, or make chosen keys turbo while it is on (turbo modifier)
settings.remap.left_maps_to.label: Maps to
settings.remap.left_maps_to.help: the host stick the physical left stick drives; if both drive one, the one pushed further wins
settings.remap.left_x_axis.label: Invert X axis
settings.remap.left_x_axis.help: inverted: the left stick's left and right are swapped
settings.remap.left_y_axis.label: Invert Y axis
settings.remap.left_y_axis.help: inverted: the left stick's up and down are swapped
settings.remap.left_inner_deadzone.label: Inner deadzone
settings.remap.left_inner_deadzone.help: left stick: percent around centre suppressed
settings.remap.left_outer_deadzone.label: Outer deadzone
settings.remap.left_outer_deadzone.help: left stick: percent of outer travel discarded
settings.remap.left_curve_enabled.label: Curve enabled
settings.remap.left_curve_enabled.help: enable left stick points; disabled passes calibrated input through exactly and retains the points
settings.remap.left_curve_points.label: Curve
settings.remap.left_curve_points.help: 15 nondecreasing output bytes (0-255) at 6.25% input intervals; endpoints fixed at zero and full
settings.remap.right_maps_to.label: Maps to
settings.remap.right_maps_to.help: the host stick the physical right stick drives; if both drive one, the one pushed further wins
settings.remap.right_x_axis.label: Invert X axis
settings.remap.right_x_axis.help: inverted: the right stick's left and right are swapped
settings.remap.right_y_axis.label: Invert Y axis
settings.remap.right_y_axis.help: inverted: the right stick's up and down are swapped
settings.remap.right_inner_deadzone.help: right stick: percent around centre suppressed
settings.remap.right_outer_deadzone.help: right stick: percent of outer travel discarded
settings.remap.right_curve_enabled.label: Curve enabled
settings.remap.right_curve_enabled.help: enable right stick points; disabled passes calibrated input through exactly and retains the points
settings.remap.right_curve_points.label: Curve
settings.remap.right_curve_points.help: 15 nondecreasing output bytes (0-255) at 6.25% input intervals; endpoints fixed at zero and full
settings.remap.rumble.label: Rumble
settings.remap.rumble.help: how strong the motors are: each step has its own motor ranges and kick (developer settings); Home+M then L1/R1 changes it until a disconnect
settings.remap.rumble_left_min.label: Rumble left min
settings.remap.rumble_left_min.help: left motor, steps 1-5: percent power for the lightest rumble; rumble between this and the max spreads evenly
settings.remap.rumble_left_max.label: Rumble left max
settings.remap.rumble_left_max.help: left motor, steps 1-5: percent power for full rumble
settings.remap.rumble_right_min.label: Rumble right min
settings.remap.rumble_right_min.help: right motor, steps 1-5: percent power for the lightest rumble
settings.remap.rumble_right_max.label: Rumble right max
settings.remap.rumble_right_max.help: right motor, steps 1-5: percent power for full rumble
settings.remap.rumble_kick_ms.label: Rumble kick ms
settings.remap.rumble_kick_ms.help: steps 1-5: a motor starting from stopped runs at full power this long first, so a low minimum still starts it; 0: no kick
settings.remap.mouse_layout.label: Mouse layout
settings.remap.mouse_layout.help: mouse: what each control does; from the next connect
settings.remap.stick_speed.label: Stick speed
settings.remap.stick_speed.help: mouse: pointer counts per second, stick all the way; from the next connect
settings.remap.gyro_speed.label: Gyro speed
settings.remap.gyro_speed.help: mouse, touchpad: counts per degree turned; 0 off; from the next connect
settings.remap.gyro_accel.label: Gyro accel
settings.remap.gyro_accel.help: mouse, touchpad: percent of gyro_speed for fast turns; from the next connect
settings.remap.l2_press.label: Digital at
settings.remap.l2_press.help: L2: percent of travel where it counts as pressed (a host's digital trigger, hair and rapid); it lets go 3% short of it
settings.remap.l2_mode.label: Analog mode
settings.remap.l2_mode.help: L2: default: the analog value as it is; hair: full from the press point, else nothing; rapid: as hair, but it lets go as soon as the trigger rises 5% and presses again 5% down, anywhere
settings.remap.r2_press.label: Digital at
settings.remap.r2_press.help: R2: percent of travel where it counts as pressed (a host's digital trigger, hair and rapid); it lets go 3% short of it
settings.remap.r2_mode.label: Analog mode
settings.remap.r2_mode.help: R2: default: the analog value as it is; hair: full from the press point, else nothing; rapid: as hair, but it lets go as soon as the trigger rises 5% and presses again 5% down, anywhere
settings.macros.macros.label: Macros
settings.macros.macros.help: up to 8 named macros: key presses, releases and waits; rules play them (macro, play macro, toggle macro); a remap slot with none plays the base's

ui.page.write_sizes_sends_the_most_data_:
Write sizes: sends the most data a command takes, in 20- and 96-byte writes, as
      settings for a target that does not exist (nothing is staged), and checks the pad parsed all of it.
      Updater round trip: restarts the pad into its updater, connects again without the chooser,
      reads it, and reboots it back into its app (the link ends).
